text:
sam: Need a compact asset pack for next week's webinar — hero slide, 3 micro-tiles, 1 one-pager. Low-effort, brand-safe, deliver by EOD Wed.

tess: Copy? reuse existing sparkline? :eyes:

sam: Reuse sparkline but relabel as 'avg token cost'. Keep hero very clean.

anya: Localization: en-US, en-GB, de. Short copy for translations. Legal flagged phrase 'inference economics' — using 'inference costs' might be safer.

leo: Specs: hero 1200x628 PNG + Figma; tiles 600x600 SVG; one-pager A4 PDF + Figma. Filename pattern: redwood_bench-webinar_YYYYMMDD_v1.

leo: Accessibility: verify contrast for CTA (#FF6A00). If <4.5:1 swap to #FF7A3A or use white outline. Include alt-text notes in Figma.

tess: Social variants needed: 1:1 crops, minimal copy, light/dark variants, no logos for paid channels.

sam: Copy (tile length <90 chars):
Hero: Serving wins: predictable inference costs for production LLMs
Subhead: Optimize batching, caching, and model routing to reduce per-token spend.
Tile1: Faster responses, lower cost — smart batching
Tile2: Pin models, rollouts, and safe fallbacks
Tile3: Dedicated pools for consistent throughput
CTA: See benchmarks → (link added at handoff)

leo: I'll post Figma link tomorrow 10:30am PT. @tess can you scaffold the page and export presets?

design-bot: deploy:asset-template-v2 applied — auto-export queued (png/svg/pdf).

sam: Label exports with environment tags (hosted/dedicated/private) so sales can pick appropriate slides.

anya: Reminder from legal: avoid absolutes like 'costless' or 'free'. Use 'reduced' or 'lower'.

leo: Got it. Will post early drafts and mark variants. :thumbsup:
